notes: U4/§5.3 non-monotone closure example. Keyset omits the org-1 and human-2 declarations; the container carries three context declarations: D_o = org-1 as organization @T0 cosigned by human-2, D_h = org-1 as human @T1 cosigned by the keyset root human-1, D_y = human-2 as human @T2 cosigned by org-1. Derivation per U4: (1) governing class comes from structurally valid declarations before/independently of trust, keyset first else smallest (recorded_at, record digest); org-1's earliest declaration is D_o @T0, so organization governs. (2) D_h claims human and is invalid E_KEY_CLASS_CONFLICT. (3) The closure runs afterwards and invalid declarations establish no trust: D_o's cosigner human-2 and D_y's cosigner org-1 have no trusted source (the dependency is circular), so D_o and D_y are unverifiable E_KEY_UNTRUSTED. Container invalid; no fixed point selects a different class.
